# SLU Game Development Skills

Portable workflow skills for SLU projects. The shared constitution in the root `AGENTS.md` is authoritative; these `SKILL.md` modules provide reusable task-specific execution contracts.

## Core build and design
- `slu-largest-playable` — build the broadest coherent, closest-to-release playable rather than defaulting to tiny MVPs.
- `slu-commercial-foundation` — inherit solved commercial genre structure quickly and differentiate through the real hook.
- `slu-content-expansion` — build substantial content through deep composition before mechanic proliferation.
- `slu-difficulty-balance` — scale information and execution before raw stats.
- `slu-companion-multiplayer` — build host-authoritative shared-display + personal-screen games with strict public/private state boundaries.

## Visuals and feel
- `slu-reference-language` — extract transferable art direction from references.
- `slu-visual-pass` — raise the whole player-visible stack coherently.
- `slu-img2threejs` — reconstruct approved hard-surface references through the official quality-gated pipeline.
- `slu-game-feel` — tune movement/camera/combat feedback without casually rewriting proven mechanics.

## Platform and accessibility
- `slu-mobile-controller` — first-class touch and controller parity across the complete player loop.
- `slu-accessibility-readability` — non-color readability, motion/flash, contrast, scaling, and multimodal cues.
- `slu-engine-decision` — migrate only for concrete blockers; port semantic systems rather than line-by-line implementations.

## Production and QA
- `slu-playtest-triage` — classify, reproduce, fix, and regression-check playtest findings while preserving good emergent tech.
- `slu-semantic-audio` — semantic events, layered authored sound, buses, spatialization, and fallbacks.
- `slu-performance-release` — worst-case performance plus complete release-loop validation.
- `slu-repo-health` — reduce bug surface and iteration friction without speculative rewrites.
- `slu-ui-copy-budget` — prevent unnecessary player-facing copy and internal terminology leakage.

Agents should apply the matching skill automatically when a task fits. Project-level `AGENTS.md` files may add stricter rules but should not weaken the shared constitution without an explicit project decision.
